data.label: 腾讯御安全
data.description: 腾讯御安全专注于为个人或企业移动应用开发者，提供全面的应用安全服务。通过对移动应用技术的持续研究，腾讯在移动应用安全领域积累了深厚的开发经验与技术，拥有强大的安全技术团队和丰富的安全数据资源库。

data.label: Tencent Yushi Security
data.description: Tencent Yusafety focuses on providing comprehensive application security services for individual or enterprise mobile application developers. Through continuous research on mobile application technology, Tencent has accumulated rich development experience and technology in the field of mobile application security, with a strong security technology team and rich security data resource library.
